name: just-convert
description: Convert local files on your computer: audio, video, images, PDFs, and Office documents. Nothing is uploaded.
long_description: Connects your assistant to the Just Convert desktop app, which converts files entirely on your machine with bundled FFmpeg, qpdf, PDFium, LibreOffice, and a PDF-to-Word engine. Requires the Just Convert app to be installed.

app_path.title: Just Convert executable
app_path.description: Only needed if Just Convert is installed somewhere unusual, or for the Linux AppImage: the path to the app executable or .AppImage file.
